description: OIS pillar weights tuned for professional services. Delivery and enterprise goals are upweighted vs the default foundation config.

pillars.rationale: PS firms live or die on fast, accurate decisions — bid/no-bid, escalation, pricing.
Enterprise goal attainment (revenue, SLA) is the primary client-facing measure.
Process consistency (milestone reviews, invoice approvals) is the delivery engine.
Goal completion rate drives team accountability and client satisfaction.
AI intelligence usage accelerates analysis and reduces manual overhead.
Pipeline health and win rates are the leading indicators of future revenue.
Governance and audit compliance are table stakes for enterprise clients.
Starts conservative; earns weight as usage data accumulates.
